This contract provides for Platform 1 improvements, which include the creation, implementation and testing of the DevOps to expedite software delivery. Work will be performed in El Segundo, California, and is expected to be completed by April 30, 2025. The cumulative contract is $36,785,701, and fiscal 2021-2024 research, development, test, and evaluation 3620 funds in the amount of $924,761 are being obligated at time of award. Space and Missile Systems Center, Los Angeles Air Force Base, California, is the contracting activity.
